**Audio Studio MCP now has a web UI.** Start the server with `--web 8765` and you can generate, compare, edit and export sounds in your browser, while your AI agent uses the same server and the same loaded model over MCP. It all still runs locally: no cloud service and no API key. Existing MCP setups keep working as before.

[🎧 Listen to samples](https://kanaworksai-hue.github.io/audio-studio-mcp/) · [English](https://github.com/kanaworksai-hue/audio-studio-mcp#readme) · [简体中文](https://github.com/kanaworksai-hue/audio-studio-mcp/blob/main/README.zh-CN.md) · [日本語](https://github.com/kanaworksai-hue/audio-studio-mcp/blob/main/README.ja.md)

## License

- The project is still MIT, but the package now also contains files under other terms:
  - The web UI bundles the **IBM Plex Sans** font (© IBM Corp.) under the **SIL Open Font License 1.1** (`src/audio_studio_mcp/static/fonts/OFL.txt`).
  - The web UI shows the **Kana** icon (`src/audio_studio_mcp/static/brand/`). Like the images in `docs/brand`, it belongs to 東京AI映像合同会社 and is not covered by the MIT license.

## New: web UI

```bash
.venv/bin/audio-studio-mcp --web 8765
```

- **One process for both.** `--web PORT` serves the page at `http://127.0.0.1:PORT/` and MCP at `/mcp` on the same port, so the browser and your agents share one loaded model. Your browser opens automatically; add `--no-browser` to skip that.
- **Generate.** Write a prompt (or start from an example), pick music, instrument or sound effect, choose a length or leave it on auto, and get up to 4 versions to compare. Jobs wait in a queue that shows each job's place and an estimated time.
- **Compare.** Keys 1–4 / A–D switch between versions at the same play position, and the space bar plays and pauses. On an AI edit, `0` plays the original for an A/B check.
- **Edit.** A waveform editor with zoom and selection. Make a variation, replace a selected part, or extend the clip. The waveform marks the part that will change.
- **Export.** Presets for game sound effects, game loops and video / YouTube, or your own settings: trim, fades, loudness, sample rate, WAV / OGG / FLAC.
- **Library.** Every sound in the output folder, including the ones your agent made, with search and type filters. Files without a `.json` sidecar show up too.
- English, 日本語 and 简体中文; light and dark themes that follow the system or can be set by hand. Fonts and images are bundled, so the page loads nothing from the internet.
- **Local only.** The server listens on `127.0.0.1` only and has no login. Requests from other websites are refused (Host, Origin and `Sec-Fetch-Site` checks), and the page can only read and edit audio files directly inside the output folder. Don't expose the port to other machines.

## Changes for MCP clients

- The four tools (`generate_audio`, `edit_audio`, `process_audio`, `unload_models`) have the same parameters, results and sidecars as in v0.2.2, and give the same audio for the same seed.
- Output file names are now capped at 160 bytes. Long titles (especially Japanese ones) and long chains of edits used to grow past the 255-byte file name limit of most file systems. When a name is cut, the middle is dropped, so the seed, the edit step (`_inpaint`, `_proc`, …), the version number (`_v2`) and a `_2` counter stay at the end.
- When a name is already taken, all candidates of one call now move on together: a second run with the same title gives `title_2_v1`, `title_2_v2` instead of `title_v1_2`, `title_v2_2`.
- New files are created with normal file permissions (`0644`) instead of being marked executable.
- `--http` and `--web` can't be combined; `--web` checks that the port is valid.

## Install

- Windows: `install.ps1` now works when the folder path contains Japanese (or other non-ASCII) characters, for example under a Japanese user name. Python 3.11 could not start from such a `.venv`, and the installer wrongly reported that you were not logged in to Hugging Face. It now also checks that the `.venv` starts and says so clearly if it doesn't.
- Both installers end by showing how to start the web UI.

## Docs

- The READMEs (English, 简体中文, 日本語) have a new **Web UI** section, and the license section lists the bundled font.

## Update

From an existing clone:

```bash
git pull
```

The web UI needs no new dependencies, so nothing has to be reinstalled. Restart your MCP client (or the server) so it loads the new version. The model weights stay as they are.

New installs follow the README as before, using `--branch v0.3.0`.

**Full changes:** https://github.com/kanaworksai-hue/audio-studio-mcp/compare/v0.2.2...v0.3.0
